_note: Synthetic report spec: mixed method (survey plus in-depth interviews). Not real BPI data.
title: Credit Card Activation Mixed-Method Study 2026
summary: An online survey of new cardholders who had not activated their card within 30 days, followed by in-depth interviews on why.

findings.text: 38% of new cardholders who had not activated their card said they did not know the activation steps (base n=600).
Annual fee worries were cited by 27% of new cardholders who had not activated their card (base n=600).
Interviewees described waiting for a first large purchase before activating, treating the card as a backup.
I kept the card in the drawer for emergencies. I didn't see why I should activate it before I needed it.
